title: Perseverance
definition: Perseverance is God’s preserving grace by which true believers are kept in faith and continue following Christ to the end.
summary: Perseverance does not mean careless living. God preserves His people through faith, discipline, warnings, promises, prayer, and the work of the Spirit.
christFocus: Christ keeps His sheep. The believer’s hope rests not in personal grip on God, but in Christ’s faithful hold on those who belong to Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God preserves His people by grace.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: True faith continues and bears fruit.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Warnings in Scripture are means God uses to keep believers watchful and dependent.
